ei.title: A Request to Extend Library Hours
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: I hope this message finds you well. As student council president, I am reaching out to discuss an important matter regarding our school library's current operating hours. At present, the library closes at 5 p.m., which many students feel limits their ability to fully use its resources for study and research after regular class hours. This is particularly challenging for those preparing for college entrance exams or working on academic projects that demand a quiet and resourceful environment. Therefore, I'd like to ask you to extend the library's operating hours to 7 p.m. This change would greatly benefit students by providing additional time to focus on their academic goals. I hope you will consider this proposal as a step toward improving our academic environment and better supporting our needs.

questions.passage: I hope this message finds you well. As student council president, I am reaching out to discuss an (A)[trivial / important] matter regarding our school library's current operating hours. At present, the library closes at 5 p.m., which many students feel limits their ability to fully use its resources for study and research after regular class hours. This is particularly (B)[challenging / effortless] for those preparing for college entrance exams or working on academic projects that demand a quiet and resourceful environment. Therefore, I'd like to ask you to extend the library's operating hours to 7 p.m. This change would greatly (C)[harm / benefit] students by providing additional time to focus on their academic goals. I hope you will consider this proposal as a step toward improving our academic environment and better supporting our needs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① trivial — challenging — benefit: (A) trivial(사소한)은 important(중요한)의 반의어
❌ ② important — effortless — benefit: (B) effortless(수월한)는 challenging(힘든)의 반의어
✅ ③ important — challenging — benefit: 원문 일치. 논의할 중요한(important) 문제, 수험생에게 힘든(challenging) 상황, 학생에게 이익을 주는(benefit) 변화라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ important — challenging — harm: (C) harm(해를 끼치다)은 benefit(이익을 주다)의 반의어
det.tip: an important matter(중요한 문제) / particularly challenging(특히 힘든) / would greatly benefit students(학생에게 크게 이익)

questions.passage: I hope this message finds you well. At present, the library closes at 5 p.m., which many students feel limits their ability to fully use its resources for study and research after regular class hours. This is particularly challenging for those preparing for college entrance exams or working on academic projects that demand a quiet and resourceful environment. Therefore, I'd like to ask you to (B)[extend / shorten] the library's operating hours to 7 p.m. This change would greatly benefit students by providing additional time to focus on their academic goals. I hope you will consider this proposal as a step toward (C)[worsening / improving] our academic environment and better supporting our needs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① discuss — extend — improving: 원문 일치. 운영 시간 문제를 논의하고자(discuss), 운영 시간을 연장(extend)해 달라고 요청하며, 학업 환경을 개선하는(improving) 단계라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② avoid — extend — improving: (A) avoid(피하다)는 discuss(논의하다)의 반의어
❌ ③ discuss — shorten — improving: (B) shorten(단축하다)은 extend(연장하다)의 반의어
❌ ④ discuss — extend — worsening: (C) worsening(악화시키는)은 improving(개선하는)의 반의어
det.tip: discuss an important matter(문제를 논의) / extend the operating hours(시간을 연장) / a step toward improving(개선을 향한 단계)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① neglecting — providing — supporting: (A) neglecting(소홀히 하는)은 preparing(준비하는)과 반대
❌ ② preparing — withholding — supporting: (B) withholding(주지 않는)은 providing(제공하는)의 반의어
❌ ③ preparing — providing — undermining: (C) undermining(약화시키는)은 supporting(지지하는)의 반의어
✅ ④ preparing — providing — supporting: 원문 일치. 시험을 준비하는(preparing) 학생들, 추가 시간을 제공함(providing)으로써, 우리의 필요를 지지하는(supporting) 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: those preparing for college entrance exams(시험 준비) / by providing additional time(시간 제공) / better supporting our needs(필요를 지지)

questions.passage:
(A) She received a beautiful birthday <u>present</u> from her closest friends last weekend.

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 present의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: present: (A) 생일 선물 / (B) At present=현재, 지금
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 선물 — (B) 현재: (A)는 친구에게 받은 생일 선물(명사), (B)는 At present(현재/지금)라는 뜻으로 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 현재 — (B) 선물: (A)의 present는 받은 물건이므로 선물이 적절
❌ ③ (A) 선물 — (B) 제시하다: (B)의 At present는 동사 제시하다가 아닌 현재
❌ ④ (A) 참석한 — (B) 현재: (A)의 present는 형용사 참석한이 아닌 명사 선물
det.tip: present: ① (명사) 선물 ② (부사구 at present) 현재 ③ (동사) 제시하다/수여하다 ④ (형용사) 참석한

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a formal plan or suggestion put forward for others to consider"

det.korean: proposal=제안 (다른 사람이 고려하도록 내놓은 공식적인 계획/제안)
det.analysis:
❌ ① complaint: complaint(불평)는 제안이 아닌 불만의 표현
✅ ② proposal: proposal(제안)은 고려하도록 내놓은 공식 계획으로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ schedule: schedule(일정)은 시간표로 제안과 다름
❌ ④ agreement: agreement(합의)는 이미 동의된 결과로 제안 단계와 다름
det.tip: proposal = 제안. a formal plan or suggestion for others to consider가 핵심

questions.passage: This change would greatly benefit students by __________ (provide) additional time to focus on their academic goals. I hope you will consider this proposal as a step toward improving our academic environment and better supporting our needs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 전치사 by 뒤에는 명사 역할을 하는 동명사(V-ing)가 와야 한다. by + V-ing은 '~함으로써'의 의미. provide → providing
det.tip: by + V-ing(동명사): ~함으로써 — 전치사 뒤에는 동명사가 온다

questions.passage: This is particularly challenging for those __________ (prepare) for college entrance exams or working on academic projects that demand a quiet environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: those(~하는 사람들)를 뒤에서 수식하는 현재분사가 필요하다. 뒤의 working과 or로 병렬 연결되므로 preparing이 적절. prepare → preparing
det.tip: those preparing ... or working ... — 분사구가 those를 수식, 두 분사가 병렬

questions.passage: I hope this message finds you well. As student council president, I am __________ to discuss an important matter regarding our school library's current operating hours. At present, the library closes at 5 p.m., which many students feel limits their ability to fully use its resources for study and research after regular class hours. This is particularly challenging for those preparing for college entrance exams or working on academic projects that demand a quiet and resourceful environment. Therefore, I'd like to ask you to extend the library's operating hours to 7 p.m. This change would greatly benefit students by providing additional time to focus on their academic goals. I hope you will consider this proposal as a step toward improving our academic environment and better supporting our needs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① reaching out: 원문 일치. 중요한 문제를 논의하고자 연락드린다(reaching out)는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② backing away: backing away(물러서다)는 논의하려 다가가는 것과 반대
❌ ③ giving up: giving up(포기하다)은 문제를 제기하려는 의도와 반대
❌ ④ holding back: holding back(자제하다)은 적극적으로 연락하는 것과 반대
det.tip: I am reaching out to discuss an important matter — 중요한 문제를 논의하고자 연락드립니다

questions.passage: I hope this message finds you well. As student council president, I am reaching out to discuss an important matter regarding our school library's current operating hours. At present, the library closes at 5 p.m., which many students feel limits their ability to fully use its resources for study and research after regular class hours. This is particularly challenging for those preparing for college entrance exams or working on academic projects that demand a quiet and resourceful environment. Therefore, I'd like to ask you to extend the library's operating hours to 7 p.m. This change would greatly benefit students by providing additional time to focus on their academic goals. I hope you will consider this proposal as a __________ improving our academic environment and better supporting our needs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: step toward=~을 향한 단계 (학업 환경 개선을 향한 단계)
det.analysis:
❌ ① barrier to: barrier to(~에 대한 장벽)는 개선을 방해하는 의미로 논지와 반대
❌ ② substitute for: substitute for(~의 대체물)는 개선의 단계라는 맥락과 다름
❌ ③ reaction to: reaction to(~에 대한 반응)는 능동적 개선 단계와 어울리지 않음
✅ ④ step toward: 원문 일치. 이 제안을 학업 환경을 개선하는 쪽으로 가는 단계(step toward)로 고려해 달라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: a step toward improving our academic environment — 학업 환경 개선을 향한 단계
